        return -1
    
    # Create a base path that includes all cities except the four given
    base_path = list(range(1, n + 1))

    if a in base_path:
        base_path.remove(a)
    if b in base_path:

    if c in base_path:
        base_path.remove(c)
    if d in base_path:
        base_path.remove(d)
    
    # Insert the given cities into the base path

    path_b = [c] + base_path[:n-1] + [d]
